title: LA Colossal – Minakari 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Pakistani woman in her late 20s, long dark side-swept waves, natural face with a soft smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Persian minakari enamel body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. Glossy sky-blue enamel base with fine gold outlines, filled with roses, irises, and hummingbirds in pink, cobalt, and white. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated on a low marble bench, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch sky-blue enamel platform stiletto d'Orsay pumps with gold trim.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, sky blue with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Mughal-style garden pavilion with marble arches, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft daylight with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
